tagline: Emerging North American uranium and lithium exploration company with prospective assets across Saskatchewan, Manitoba, and Quebec
hero_kpi_rationale: The company has made significant investments in lithium and uranium exploration assets, which are central to its strategy. Exploration assets increased from $15.09M to $21.32M, reflecting intensified exploration activities and strategic positioning in the clean resources sector.

kpis.name: Exploration Assets
kpis.explanation: Value of geological exploration projects held by the company.
kpis.description: Exploration assets increased from $15.09M CAD to $21.32M CAD, reflecting intensified exploration activities on uranium properties in Saskatchewan and lithium properties in Manitoba and Quebec.
kpis.signal: Significant investment in lithium and uranium exploration

kpis.name: Accumulated Deficit
kpis.explanation: Total accumulated losses incurred by the company since inception.
kpis.description: The deficit reached $24.46M CAD in March 2025, up 14% year-on-year, reflecting the absence of operating revenues and ongoing exploration expenditures.
kpis.signal: Company in pre-revenue phase with growing losses

kpis.name: Cash
kpis.explanation: Amount of cash and cash equivalents on the balance sheet.
kpis.description: Cash reached $5.0M CAD in March 2025, up from $0.998M CAD in 2024, driven by capital raises to fund the exploration program.
kpis.signal: Cash significantly increased through 2025 financing activities

kpis.name: Professional Fees
kpis.explanation: Expenses related to legal, accounting, financial, and exploration consulting services.
kpis.description: Professional fees rose sharply to $1.93M CAD in 2025, likely tied to financing activities, SEC regulatory compliance, and technical exploration advisory.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in compliance, financing, and technical advisory costs

kpis.name: Investor Relations and Promotion

risks.title: Failure to meet exploration option and obligation payments
risks.score_rationale: Risk presented first in Item 1A, direct language ("will lose"), existential impact on operational continuity. High weight: total loss of mineral rights and prior investments if mandatory payment schedules are not met.

risks.title: Insufficient financing for exploration programs
risks.score_rationale: Major risk repeated 4 times in Item 1A with increasing intensity. Company in pre-commercial exploration phase (no revenue), limited cash ($5M CAD), substantial annual losses ($3.6-4.5M). Going concern doubt explicitly mentioned.

risks.title: Uncontrollable mining operational risks
risks.score_rationale: Detailed section listing 15+ operational risks (earthquakes, floods, collapses, geological issues). Language: "generally outside of our control", "could adversely affect". Lack of insurance explicitly stated.

risks.title: Uncertainty regarding commercial viability of mineral deposits
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental risk repeated 5 times. Language: "no assurance", "extremely risky", "few properties...are ultimately developed". No commercially viable mineral resources confirmed. Direct impact on business model and ROI.

risks.title: Dependence on government permits and approvals
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements and operational risks ("delays in receipt of or failure to receive necessary government permits"). Mining sector highly regulated. Risk of delays or denials impacting exploration timelines.

risks.title: Commodity price volatility (lithium, uranium)
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: "metal prices that are highly cyclical" and "low commodity prices may affect our ability to obtain financing". Direct impact on project financability and economic viability. Major uncontrollable external factor.

risks.title: Limited operating history and absence of revenues
risks.score_rationale: Credibility risk: company incorporated in 2005, no revenue generated, exploration-only phase. Language: "limited operating history makes evaluating...difficult". Increases investment risk but less critical than financing.

risks.title: Environmental risks and regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements ("environmental issues", "complying with existing and proposed environmental laws"). Mining sector subject to increasing environmental regulation. Risk of unanticipated additional costs.
